comments: The free scan tests a single page against WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA success criteria via axe-core. Paid tiers add multi-page crawls (up to 1,000 pages), scheduled re-scans, and remediation roadmaps. Data point: across 5,410 small-business sites scanned Feb-Jul 2026, 96% had at least one WCAG violation.
features: AdaScanPro scans web pages for WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA issues using the axe-core rules engine and returns an A-F accessibility score with the top violations and remediation guidance in under 60 seconds. Free single-page scan; paid plans scan up to 1,000 pages with scheduled monitoring, PDF reports, and score-drop alerts.
title: AdaScanPro
